services.heading: What we can build.
services.lede: From the first question to a system running reliably, we cover the whole path: research, design, build, run and handover.

items.title: Product design
items.body: User flows, interfaces and a design system built in Figma and Linear, before the first line of code.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.body: Native apps for iOS and Android with SwiftUI, Kotlin and Java, or one codebase across both with Flutter and React Native.

items.title: Web platforms
items.body: Websites and web apps with Next.js, React and TypeScript, styled with Tailwind CSS for a consistent interface that is easy to extend.

items.title: Backend and data
items.body: APIs and databases with NestJS, Spring Boot, Postgres, MongoDB and Redis, including the real-time part.

items.title: Infrastructure and operations
items.body: The product is packaged, automated with GitHub Actions, and set up on the infrastructure that fits where you already run. Monitoring, incident handling and maintenance continue after handover.

products.heading: Our products.
products.lede: Each product starts from a real problem, in any market we serve.

items.title: Talk
items.body: You describe the problem and we listen. We are happy to sign an NDA before the first call.

items.title: Project analysis
items.body: We read the problem properly, then assess what is feasible, what the risks are, and what has to be in place to build it.

items.title: Agree the scope
items.body: Scope, cost, timeline and ownership are written down from the start.

items.title: Build
items.body: We design and code, working on whichever chat channel suits you, with Linear and video calls when it helps.

items.title: Hand over
items.body: You receive the full source code, technical documentation and an operations guide.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Six to twelve weeks for an MVP, and three to six months for a full platform. The real number depends on scope and integration depth, not on budget.

items.q: Do you sign an NDA before discussing details?
items.a: Yes. We sign a one-way or mutual NDA before the first conversation. If you have your own template, send it by email.

items.q: How many projects do you take at once?
items.a: Client projects run alongside our in-house products. The schedule changes each quarter, so ask for current availability before sending a brief.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Da Nang?
items.a: Yes. Most of our outsource clients are in Hanoi, HCMC and Singapore. We work on whichever chat channel suits you, with Linear, and by video when it helps.

items.q: Can I keep developing after handover?
items.a: Yes. Every project ships with technical documentation, an operations guide and the full source.
